From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Subject: Slate lockdown: OKR orchestration + QBR dry-run

Team —

We're at the finish line for the quarter slate and I want to lock the OKR matrix and run one full QBR dry-run before the exec readout. Key asks below:

1) Review the attached OKR matrix (OKR_matrix_v3.xlsx) and QBR packet (QBR_packet_v1.pdf) for any final content/metric asks by EOD Wednesday (3/7).
2) Confirm owner-level signoffs for objectives you own — if there's any risk or M turned-on metrics, flag them inline in the matrix.
3) Dry-run: propose Thu 3/8 10:00–11:00 PT for a 60m run-through (slides + two mock Q&A scenarios). If this doesn't work, suggest alternatives.

A few notes:
- We're tightening measurement windows to reduce ambiguity on adoption metrics; see comments on slide 7.
- Cost assumptions (Optimize recommendations) are included; Marcus, please validate the throughput/cost deltas.
- Kimberly, please call out any compliance/regulatory items you want surfaced in the QBR.

I'll compile any redlines and reissue a clean packet on Thursday morning. Thanks for quick turn here — we need the final signoffs to meet the exec deadline next week.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

• Slide 11 (data residency): we should surface the compliance artifact links (SOC2 attestation, KMS doc) in the packet; otherwise partners will ask.

I can take the risk note and add the compliance links by tomorrow morning. Thu 10:00 PT works for me.

- Metric refinement for Objective 1: split business outcome vs. product adoption (two separate KPIs) so success/failure paths are clearer.

Great — thanks all for the quick turn. Quick summary and actions: 

1) Kimberly: you will add the compliance artifact links and a short risk note to Slide 11 by 9am Thu.
2) Marcus: finalize cost sensitivity numbers and confirm the unit token cost delta in the matrix by EOD Wed (you said you'd validate tonight).
3) Lauren: consolidate owner signoffs in the 'approved' column of the OKR matrix; close any open actions by EOD Wed.
4) Aditya: run the dry-run calendar invite and include the mock Q&A deck (I'll draft two scenarios).
5) Sunny: please join the dry-run to validate partner-facing slides — thanks for the mapping note on events/metric names.

I'll produce the 'clean' packet on Thu 3/8 at 08:00 PT and we will meet for the dry-run at 10:00–11:00 PT. If any of you cannot make the dry-run, flag it now and we will schedule a short follow-up.

Thanks — confident we can close this out.
